LINGMAI ECHOES / 灵脉回响

Aftertouch: adapted World scene, terrain and grass shaders, growth events, particles, timeline rewind, pointer interaction and sound synthesis.
Original source is retained in references/; three ecological islands and animal models are additions.
Source: https://github.com/NickChaps/aftertouch
